title: atlas-collection: the atlas hooks of a STAC Collection
description: The atlas: fields a STAC Collection carries for the atlas app: credits (funders, access, note), the flower plot, the species of a clicked raster cell, a taxa registry with its item template, the pairing of a mean surface with its uncertainty, and value labels on the cube dimensions. Every field is optional; when present it has the shape atlas/src/lib/catalog/*.ts parses. Written by the atlas pipeline and workflows/R/eov_share.R. STAC core is out of scope: only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through.

atlas:funders.description: the funders credited (BOEM, MBON ...), until a STAC field exists

atlas:access.description: restricted: the collection is shown only to signed-in users with access; absent = public

atlas:note.description: the one sentence the collection wants seen beside its credits (e.g. a licence condition)

atlas:flower.description: a flower plot on a raster click: the petals are the sibling items across dimension, the centre the composite value of it

dimension.description: the cube:dimensions key the petals run across (e.g. eov)

composite.description: the value of dimension that is the centre (e.g. all)

atlas:cell_species.description: the species of a clicked raster cell: a tiled cell -> species Parquet (one file per tile_deg square) and a species lookup asset

asset.description: the asset key of the tiled table (for its columns and size)

lookup_asset.description: the asset key of the species lookup Parquet

layout.description: how the table is split; tiles is the only layout

tile_deg.description: the side of a tile in degrees (e.g. 5)

href_template.description: the path of one tile, relative to the collection, with {tile} left in

grid.description: the raster grid the cell ids are numbered on: row-major from the top-left, 1-based

key_column.description: the tile column holding the cell id

species_column.description: the tile column holding the species id

value_column.description: the tile column holding the value (e.g. suitability)

lookup_key.description: the lookup column joined to species_column; absent = species_column

value_label.description: the heading of the value column; absent = Value

group_column.description: the lookup column grouping the species (e.g. eov)

share.description: a species' share of its global habitat, when published

total_column.description: the lookup column holding a species' total suitable area

formula.description: the share formula, for the reader

items.description: a link takes its URL from a lookup column or fills an href_template from the lookup row

column.description: the lookup column holding the URL

href_template.description: a URL with {name} placeholders filled from the lookup row

same_app.description: true for a URL of the atlas itself, followed in place

atlas:taxa_registry.description: a registry-backed taxon collection: one row per taxon in a Parquet asset, each row made into an Item by atlas:item_template

asset.description: the asset key of the registry Parquet

key_column.description: the column keying a taxon; absent = sp_key

search_columns.description: the columns the search box matches; absent = scientific_name, common_name

group_column.description: the column grouping the taxa (e.g. sp_cat)

index_asset.description: the asset key of the compact search index JSON, when the registry is large

legacy_key_column.description: the column holding a taxon's key in the previous release, for old links

atlas:item_template.description: how a registry row becomes an Item: an Item skeleton whose strings carry {column} placeholders (free form)

atlas:uncertainty.description: pairs a mean surface with its uncertainty: as sibling items along a cube dimension (e.g. variable: density / cv), or as two bands of the same COG

pair.description: dimension: the two are sibling items along dimension; band: they are bands of one asset

dimension.description: the cube:dimensions key the pair runs along (required when pair is dimension)

kind.description: the uncertainty measure: coefficient of variation, standard error, standard deviation, or a 90 or 95 percent interval width

mean.description: the dimension value (pair dimension) or the 1-based band (pair band) of the mean

uncertainty.description: the dimension value (pair dimension) or the 1-based band (pair band) of the uncertainty

cube:dimensions.description: the datacube dimensions; an atlas selector dimension may carry value labels and the taxon flag. Other datacube keys pass through.

atlas:labels.description: the human label of each value, keyed by the value

atlas:taxon_dim.description: true for the dimension that picks a taxon
